label: Recognise shapes
tooltip: Finds flat faces and the buttons, pockets, slots, ring segments, holes and free outlines on them, and builds them as editable sketches and extrusions.
nothingFound: No shapes found. Is the scan aligned and does it have flat faces?
needsBody: Pockets and holes are cut from a body. Create the base body first and choose it here; without a body only the raised shapes are built.
help: Recognition reads the aligned scan like a designer: flat faces and, on them, raised shapes, pockets and holes. Every outline is made of lines and arcs; where a basic shape fits (circle, cut circle, slot, rectangle, ring segment) it carries its name, otherwise it is a free outline. Equal shapes are made equal, sizes rounded to 0.05 mm. In the view, outlines show the foot and top of every shape; clicking its label or its check box leaves it out. OK builds a plane per face, a sketch per height and an extrusion per group, all editable in the project tree afterwards.
